_comment: Fixes applied to a WORKSPACE COPY of the iHRIS 5 IG source before fhir-harness builds it (src/tools/build_ihris5_ig.sh). The mounted source (ihris5-source/) and iHRIS/iHRIS itself are never edited: this folio describes iHRIS 5, and each entry here is a defect to report upstream, not a fork. Every patch names the exact text it replaces, so a patch whose text is no longer there FAILS the build rather than silently doing nothing; when the pin in ihris5.json moves past an upstream fix, delete the entry.

patches.find:
Description:    "iHRIS flag for roles to indicate a primary role for assignment to users."
* ^context[1].type = #element
* ^context[1].expression = "IhrisRole"
patches.replace:
Description:    "iHRIS flag for roles to indicate a primary role for assignment to users."
* ^context[0].type = #element
* ^context[0].expression = "IhrisRole"
patches.reason: Extension IhrisRolePrimary sets ^context[1] with no context[0], so SUSHI 3 emits StructureDefinition.context [null, {...}] and IG Publisher 2.3.4 refuses to parse it ('Not a JSON Object: null'). The extension has exactly one context; index 0 is what was meant. Found 2026-10-09 building the IG with fhir-harness.
